The issuer exhibits strong financial performance with substantial revenue ($24.48B) and solid profitability (net income of $1.79B, operating margin of 11%). However, its leverage is relatively high, with total liabilities of $56.84B against shareholders' equity of $16.23B (debt-to-equity ratio of approximately 3.5), and its liquidity profile is modest with a current ratio of 1.22. These balanced factors of robust operating earnings and moderate-to-high leverage support a solid investment-grade rating in the lower-middle tier.

DECISION: BBB
